settings.name: harness
settings.description: native runs jobs through the built-in PULSE harness; copilot-cli keeps the legacy npm CLI path

settings.name: provider
settings.description: model provider the native harness uses

settings.name: harness.max_steps
settings.description: maximum tool/model steps a harness run may take

settings.name: harness.step_timeout
settings.description: seconds one command or provider step may run before the harness stops it

settings.name: harness.output_limit
settings.description: characters of command output kept in the prompt and transcript

settings.name: harness.max_cost
settings.description: provider units one harness run may spend before the harness stops it; 0 means no cap

settings.name: harness.keep_observations
settings.description: recent command observations kept in the model prompt when older output is summarized

settings.name: harness.context_window
settings.description: tokens of context the native harness assumes the model takes: past 80% of it older observations collapse harder; 0 reads the window from the provider's model list (1M for the Claude and Gemini models that take it, Copilot's per-model limit), and a model that lists none keeps context discipline at its first level

settings.name: harness.system_prompt
settings.description: custom harness system prompt template; empty uses the built-in default

settings.name: harness.instructions
settings.description: on: a native-harness run reads the clone's repository instruction files - AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md - into its system prompt; off: the task alone speaks for the repository

settings.name: harness.mcp_tools
settings.description: on: a native-harness run with a store connects the project's enabled MCP servers at its start and offers their tools to the model as mcp__<server>__<tool>; off: workers call servers through pulse mcp call only

settings.name: light_model
settings.description: model used for lead, reflect and other light runs; empty means worker_model
